range_rule: [min(A,C)/10, max(100C,3M)] per term, frozen for a study, the same in both of its folds.
starting_candidates: C and M, enqueued first in both seeds and in the full stage.
cross_fit: Each study runs twice: tune on one sequence and test on the other, then the reverse.
repeated_selection: Top two full candidates plus C and M, deduplicated by exact parameter vector, receive N=3 on the tuning sequence. The selected candidate minimizes the same declared score.
test: The frozen winner runs N=1 in VIO and N=1 in VIO-LC where supported on the other sequence. Later, two more VIO repetitions reach N=3 on the same commit and worktree. Test runs never feed selection.
score: 10 * failed_observation_count + 0.5 * mean(residual) + 0.5 * max(residual); residual = RMSE/(reference_path_length+RMSE) + unsupported_export_fraction. Existing numerical and 90% export-support gates retained. Lower is better.

delivery_policy.voxel_camera_rate_gate: Audit the expected native timestamp gate from its recorded frequency; do not change sampling or accept unexplained missing input.
delivery_policy.basis: exact native receipts; never chosen using ATE

scheduling.develop: One fold per lane at a time, one attempt per lane; a fold keeps to its declared lanes. An exclusive fold starts only after every other fold, with the host idle.
scheduling.test: Same lanes, after every selection of the dataset is frozen.

disclosures: Range constants were checked against the first search: the plan compared old selected values with candidate ranges before freezing this one. Under [min(A,C)/10, max(100C,3M)] one old winner falls outside (AirSLAM Rosario, selection score 0.0142 to 0.0156).
strawberry03 is 242 s, so its two 180-s clips overlap: {"hortimulti/strawberry03": 117.732076605} seconds.
limitations: Each recording was inspected before, in Rule C and in the first search.
M reads the IMU of both sequences of a dataset, so a fold's range knows its test sequence's IMU level. It reads no trajectory and no reference.
Two clips probe short-horizon behaviour; equal proposal counts, not equal CPU time.
Runtimes from concurrent lanes are labelled overlapped.
